This is a lesson on one conga part the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Tumbao, two drums**. It is built up from a simpler pattern, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read what the band will play on the staff underneath: the whole pass is written out when Play starts, before it sounds. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Conga parts](index.qmd#congas)

## The pattern

The tumbao in the first bar. In the second, the right hand plays two open tones on the lower drum, on the and of 2 and on 3, in place of the toe and the heel; then the left-hand toe and the two open tones of beat 4 on the higher drum. The low drum belongs to the bar with three clave notes, which is the second bar of the 2-3 clave.

It belongs in *Son montuno*, *Cha-cha* and *Boogaloo*. Here it is in the son montuno style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

## Step 1: Tumbao

Start with something simpler. The basic conga part, on one drum with the hands alternating: left-hand heel on 1, left-hand toe on the and of 1, a right-hand slap on 2, left toe on the and of 2, left heel on 3, left toe on the and of 3, then two right-hand open tones on 4 and the and of 4. Heel and toe are quiet; slap and open tones carry.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](congas-tumbao.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The bass plays with you; switch the drums and chords on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="montuno" data-chart="C|F|G7|C" data-tempo="70" data-on="congas bass" data-staves="congas" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Tumbao","opts":{"congas":"tumbao"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Tumbao, two drums, slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** The tumbao, then in the second bar the right hand moves to the lower drum for two open tones on the and of 2 and on 3, then back up.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="montuno" data-chart="C|F|G7|C" data-tempo="70" data-on="congas bass" data-staves="congas" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Tumbao, two drums","opts":{"congas":"tumbao2"}},{"label":"Tumbao (the step before)","opts":{"congas":"tumbao"}}]'></div>

The whole band, at 100 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's congas off and take the part yourself.
